biology: It lives in the soil with entirely subterranean nests, and feeds mainly on tree stumps and on wooden posts near ground level.
distribution: Yunnan: Menghan, Menghai and Yunjinghong (500 m a.s.l.); Hainan.
soldier: Head dark yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow or slightly mixed with pink; setae on the head very few, those on the thorax, abdomen and legs more numerous. Anterior part of the head slightly narrowed, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the widest point in the posterior part of the head, the lateral margins slightly arched. Fontanelle situated at about one-fifth of the anterior part of the head, very indistinct. Posterior end of the postmentum broader than the anterior end, and in lateral view the postmentum does not bulge strongly from the ventral surface of the head. Mandibles sickle-shaped, the left marginal tooth behind the midpoint, its apex directed obliquely forwards, the portion anterior to the tooth markedly narrowed; the right mandibular tooth very indistinct and situated slightly further back. Apex of the labrum reaching the midpoint of the mandibles. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, the terminal segment about equal in length to segment 2 but tapering at the tip, segment 4 equal in length to segments 2 and 3. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a distinct median concavity. Length of head to the apex of the labrum 2.18–2.38 mm, width of head 1.72–1.86 mm, width of pronotum 0.97–1.02 mm.
worker: Head deep yellow, abdomen pale yellow. Head shape intermediate between round and square, the vertex flat; the fontanelle in the middle of the vertex is a conspicuous white circular pit; the postclypeus is raised upwards, with a distinct median longitudinal suture whose length is less than half its width; antennae with 18 segments, segments 2 and 3 of similar length, segment 4 shorter, some individuals having only 17 segments.
